name: The Demons We Hide
source:
In a fictional world based on medieval Poland, you are set to be executed for high treason. "I didn't do it. I wasn't myself!" You cry to the executioner. Will he spare you, or will you pay for what you (supposedly) did? 

[From [url=https://barley-bear.itch.io/the-demons-we-hide]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个以中世纪波兰为背景的虚构世界中，你将因叛国罪被处决。“我没有这么做。我不是我自己！”你向刽子手哭泣。他会饶恕你，还是你会为你（据称）的所作所为付出代价？

[来自[url=https://barley-bear.itch.io/the-demons-we-hide]Itch.io[/url]]
